attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Mouseover Fear
macros.desc: Fear another enemy without losing your main target.
macros.needs: Fear learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Medo
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Medo

macros.title: Call your demon back
macros.desc: Stop its attack and bring it back before it breaks crowd control or pulls another enemy.
macros.needs: A living demon
macros.codePt:
/petpassive
/petfollow

macros.title: Summon a demon with modifier keys
macros.desc: Summon your Voidwalker, or hold a modifier to call a different demon instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Summon Imp; [mod:ctrl] Summon Succubus; [mod:alt] Summon Felhunter; Summon Voidwalker
macros.needs: Each demon's summon learned. The Incubus is its own summon in Forever and isn't on this button. We haven't confirmed the Soul Shard cost of each summon
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Evocar Diabrete; [mod:ctrl] Evocar Súcubo; [mod:alt] Evocar Caçador Vil; Evocar Emissário do Caos

macros.title: Pick your curse with a modifier key
macros.desc: Curse your mouseover or target with Curse of the Elements, or hold a modifier for Weakness, Recklessness or Tongues.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Curse of Weakness; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Curse of Recklessness; [mod:alt] Curse of Tongues; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Curse of the Elements

keys.text: Curse of Tongues on your target

macros.needs: Each curse learned (Elements at 20, Tongues at 26). Blizzard removed Curse of Shadow, and Curse of the Elements now covers every magic school
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Maldição da Fraqueza; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Maldição da Temeridade; [mod:alt] Maldição de Línguas; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Maldição dos Elementos

macros.title: Dot sequence for leveling
macros.desc: Send your demon in, then press repeatedly to run Immolate, Bane of Agony and Corruption and finish with your wand.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/castsequence reset=target Immolate, Bane of Agony, Corruption, !Shoot
macros.needs: Bane of Agony learned (level 8); a wand equipped for the last step; a demon out
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/castsequence reset=target Imolação, Ruína da Agonia, Corrupção, !Atirar

macros.title: Wand without toggling it off
macros.desc: Start your wand and keep pressing the button without switching Shoot off again.
macros.needs: A wand equipped
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip 18
/cast !Atirar

macros.title: Use your Healthstone
macros.desc: Use whichever Healthstone you're carrying, and hold Shift to start Drain Life in the same press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use Major Healthstone
/use Greater Healthstone
/use Healthstone
/use Lesser Healthstone
/use Minor Healthstone
/cast [mod:shift] Drain Life

keys.text: Use it and start Drain Life on your target

macros.needs: A Healthstone in your bags (Create Healthstone at 10)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use Pedra de Vida Elevada
/use Pedra de Vida Maior
/use Pedra de Vida
/use Pedra de Vida Inferior
/use Pedra de Vida Menor
/cast [mod:shift] Drenar Vida

macros.title: Soulstone your mouseover or target
macros.desc: Use your Soulstone on the friendly player under your cursor, or on your target if nothing's hovered.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Major Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Greater Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Lesser Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Minor Soulstone
macros.needs: A Soulstone in your bags (Create Soulstone at 18)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Major Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Greater Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Lesser Soulstone
/use [@mouseover,help,nodead][] Minor Soulstone

macros.title: Create your stones with one button
macros.desc: Create a Healthstone, or hold a modifier to create a Soulstone, Spellstone or Firestone instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Create Soulstone; [mod:ctrl] Create Spellstone; [mod:alt] Create Firestone; Create Healthstone
macros.needs: Each Create spell learned (Soulstone 18, Firestone 28, Spellstone 36). Firestone and Spellstone are weapon imbues in Forever and stack with wizard oil
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Criar Pedra da Alma; [mod:ctrl] Criar Pedra Mágica; [mod:alt] Criar Pedra de Fogo; Criar Pedra de Vida

macros.title: Announce Ritual of Summoning
macros.desc: Tell your party who you're summoning, then start the ritual on your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Ritual of Summoning
/party Summoning %t, please click the portal
/cast Ritual of Summoning
macros.needs: A party member targeted, plus two more players to click the portal
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ritual de Evocação
/party Summoning %t, please click the portal
/cast Ritual de Evocação

macros.title: Demon Armor, Shift for Shadow Ward
macros.desc: Refresh Demon Armor, or hold Shift for Shadow Ward before incoming Shadow damage. Each press casts only the spell you choose.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Shadow Ward; Demon Armor
/cast [mod:shift] Shadow Ward; Demon Armor
macros.needs: Demon Armor and Shadow Ward learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Proteção contra Sombra; Armadura Demoníaca
/cast [mod:shift] Proteção contra Sombra; Armadura Demoníaca

macros.title: Mouseover Bane of Agony
macros.desc: Apply Forever’s renamed damage-over-time spell to a mouseover or your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bane of Agony
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Bane of Agony
macros.needs: Bane of Agony learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ruína da Agonia
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Ruína da Agonia

macros.title: Mouseover Corruption
macros.desc: Spread Corruption without switching away from your main target.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Corrupção
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Corrupção

macros.title: Mouseover Siphon Life
macros.desc: Put Siphon Life on your mouseover without changing target, or on your target if nothing's hovered.
macros.needs: Siphon Life talent (level 30)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sifão de Vida
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Sifão de Vida

macros.title: Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life, Wrack
macros.desc: Send your demon in and press repeatedly to lay your dots one after another and finish with Wrack.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/castsequence reset=target Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life, Wrack
macros.needs: Siphon Life and Wrack learned (Wrack needs Siphon Life, level 40); a demon out
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/castsequence reset=target Corrupção, Ruína da Agonia, Sifão de Vida, Destruição

macros.title: Amplify Curse into Bane of Agony
macros.desc: Pop Amplify Curse and start Bane of Agony in one press, which Forever's Amplify Curse now boosts by 50%.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bane of Agony
/cast Amplify Curse
/cast Bane of Agony
macros.needs: Amplify Curse talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ruína da Agonia
/cast Amplificar Maldição
/cast Ruína da Agonia

macros.title: One button for your channels
macros.desc: Start Drain Life, Drain Soul or Wrack from one button without restarting a channel you're already in, and use Alt for Life Tap.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:alt] Life Tap; [nochanneling,mod:ctrl] Wrack; [nochanneling,mod:shift] Drain Soul; [nochanneling] Drain Life

keys.text: Life Tap, which also ends a channel

macros.needs: Wrack learned (level 40)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:alt] Conversão de Vida; [nochanneling,mod:ctrl] Destruição; [nochanneling,mod:shift] Drenar Alma; [nochanneling] Drenar Vida

macros.title: Mouseover Drain Soul
macros.desc: Drain Soul your mouseover or target for a shot at a Soul Shard, without restarting a channel you're already in.
macros.needs: Drain Soul learned; only non-trivial targets can give a shard
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Drenar Alma
/cast [nochanneling,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nochanneling] Drenar Alma

macros.title: Send your demon, then open with a dot
macros.desc: Send your demon at the target and open with Corruption, or with Bane of Agony or Immolate on a modifier.
macros.needs: A demon out
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/cast [mod:shift] Ruína da Agonia; [mod:ctrl] Imolação; Corrupção

macros.title: Health Funnel, Shift to stop
macros.desc: Channel into your living demon. Repeated presses won't restart Health Funnel; hold Shift to stop once your pet is healthy.

keys.text: Channel Health Funnel without restarting it

macros.needs: Health Funnel learned; living pet
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Funil de Vida
/stopcasting [mod:shift]
/stopmacro [mod:shift]
/cast [@pet,exists,nodead,nochanneling:Health Funnel] Funil de Vida

macros.title: Mouseover Subjugate Demon
macros.desc: Use Forever’s renamed demon control spell on a mouseover.
macros.needs: Subjugate Demon learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Subjugar Demônio
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Subjugar Demônio

macros.title: Fel Domination and summon
macros.desc: Fire Fel Domination and start the summon in the same press: Voidwalker, or a modifier for another demon.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast Fel Domination
/cast [mod:shift] Summon Imp; [mod:ctrl] Summon Succubus; [mod:alt] Summon Felhunter; Summon Voidwalker
macros.needs: Fel Domination talent (level 25) and each demon learned. Its cooldown is 5 minutes in Forever
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast Dominância Vil
/cast [mod:shift] Evocar Diabrete; [mod:ctrl] Evocar Súcubo; [mod:alt] Evocar Caçador Vil; Evocar Emissário do Caos

macros.title: Sacrifice, then summon a different demon
macros.desc: Sacrifice your demon for its 2 hour effect and summon another one straight away.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Demonic Sacrifice
/cast Demonic Sacrifice
/cast [mod:shift] Summon Imp; [mod:ctrl] Summon Voidwalker; [mod:alt] Summon Succubus; Summon Felhunter
macros.needs: Demonic Sacrifice and Demonic Pact talents, with a demon out. Pact needs 31 Demonology points, level 40 in the planner; we haven't tested when it unlocks in game. Summoning the demon you sacrificed ends the effect.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sacrifício Demoníaco
/cast Sacrifício Demoníaco
/cast [mod:shift] Evocar Diabrete; [mod:ctrl] Evocar Emissário do Caos; [mod:alt] Evocar Súcubo; Evocar Caçador Vil

macros.title: Summon your Succubus or Incubus
macros.desc: Summon your Succubus, or hold Shift for the Incubus, which is its own summon in Forever.
macros.needs: Summon Succubus and Summon Incubus, both learned at 20. Either one gives the Fire damage sacrifice
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Evocar Íncubo; Evocar Súcubo

macros.title: Mouseover Banish
macros.desc: Banish a demon or elemental under your cursor without leaving your main target.
macros.needs: Banish learned; it only works on Demons and Elementals
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Banir
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Banir

macros.title: Summon your Voidwalker or call it back
macros.desc: Summon the Voidwalker when it's missing or dead, otherwise send it back to your side.
macros.needs: Summon Voidwalker learned (level 10)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Evocar Emissário do Caos
/cast [nopet][@pet,dead] Evocar Emissário do Caos
/petfollow [pet]

macros.title: Unending Breath and Detect Invisibility
macros.desc: Give Unending Breath to your mouseover, friendly target or yourself, and hold Shift for Detect Invisibility instead.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help][mod:shift,@player] Detectar Invisibilidade; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help][@player] Fôlego Interminável

macros.title: Voidwalker Torment on your mouseover or target
macros.desc: Taunt your mouseover with the Voidwalker, or the enemy you're targeting.
macros.needs: A living Voidwalker (level 10)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tormento
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Tormento

macros.title: Shadow Bolt and pet attack
macros.desc: Send your demon at the enemy as you begin Shadow Bolt.
macros.needs: Living demon for the pet command
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta Sombria
/petattack
/cast Seta Sombria

macros.title: Mouseover Immolate
macros.desc: Apply Immolate to another enemy without changing targets.
macros.needs: Immolate learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Imolação
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Imolação

macros.title: Mouseover Conflagrate
macros.desc: Conflagrate a mouseover that's carrying your Immolate, or your target if nothing's hovered.
macros.needs: Conflagrate talent, which you can reach at level 25 in Forever
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Conflagrar
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Conflagrar

macros.title: Immolate, then Incinerate
macros.desc: Send your demon in and press repeatedly: Immolate first, then five Incinerates that hit harder while Immolate is on the target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/castsequence reset=target Immolate, Incinerate, Incinerate, Incinerate, Incinerate, Incinerate
macros.needs: Incinerate talent (level 40); a demon out
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/castsequence reset=target Imolação, Incinerar, Incinerar, Incinerar, Incinerar, Incinerar

macros.title: Mouseover Shadowburn
macros.desc: Finish a mouseover with Shadowburn, and you get a Soul Shard back if it dies within 8 seconds.
macros.needs: Shadowburn talent and a Soul Shard to cast it
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sombra Ardente
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Sombra Ardente

macros.title: Hellfire on and off
macros.desc: Start Hellfire and press again to stop it, since it burns you as well as nearby enemies. It can critically strike after the October 1 update.
macros.needs: Hellfire learned (level 30)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo do Inferno
/stopcasting [channeling:Hellfire]
/stopmacro [channeling:Hellfire]
/cast Fogo do Inferno

macros.title: Mouseover Bane of Havoc
macros.desc: Put Bane of Havoc on the enemy under your cursor, or on your target, so 15% of your damage to other targets also hits it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bane of Havoc
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Bane of Havoc
macros.needs: Bane of Havoc talent. It takes the Bane slot on that enemy, so Bane of Agony can't share it
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ruína Devastadora
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Ruína Devastadora

macros.title: Pick your nuke with a modifier key
macros.desc: Cast Shadow Bolt, or hold a modifier for Incinerate, Conflagrate or Shadowburn.
macros.needs: Incinerate, Conflagrate and Shadowburn talents, and a Soul Shard for Shadowburn
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Incinerar; [mod:ctrl] Conflagrar; [mod:alt] Sombra Ardente; Seta Sombria

macros.title: Shadow Bolt with an Imp Firebolt command
macros.desc: Cast Shadow Bolt at your target and request Firebolt at your Imp's current enemy. This doesn't send the Imp to a new target or bypass its mana, cast time or cooldown.
macros.needs: A living Imp with Firebolt learned and an enemy target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta Sombria
/cast [harm,nodead] Seta Sombria
/cast [@pettarget,harm,nodead] Seta de Fogo

macros.title: Drop your cast and Fear
macros.desc: Cancel whatever you're casting, hop off your mount and Fear your target, or your mouseover with Shift.

keys.text: Cancel your cast and Fear your target

macros.needs: Fear learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Medo
/dismount
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Medo

macros.title: Death Coil or Howl of Terror
macros.desc: Cancel your cast and Death Coil your target, or your mouseover with Shift, or Howl of Terror with Ctrl.

keys.text: Cancel your cast and Death Coil your target
Cancel your cast and Howl of Terror

macros.needs: Death Coil (level 42) and Howl of Terror (level 40) learned. Death Coil has a 2 minute cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:ctrl] Uivo do Terror; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Espiral da Morte

macros.title: Curse of Tongues, Exhaustion, Weakness or Elements
macros.desc: Curse your mouseover or target with Tongues, or hold a modifier for Exhaustion, Weakness or the Elements.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Curse of Exhaustion; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Curse of Weakness; [mod:alt] Curse of the Elements; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Curse of Tongues

keys.text: Curse of the Elements on your target

macros.needs: Curse of Exhaustion talent (level 25); Tongues at 26
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Maldição da Exaustão; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Maldição da Fraqueza; [mod:alt] Maldição dos Elementos; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Maldição de Línguas

macros.title: Drain Life, Drain Mana or Life Tap
macros.desc: Drain Life your target without restarting the channel, or hold a modifier for a mouseover, Drain Mana or Life Tap.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:alt] Life Tap; [nochanneling,mod:ctrl] Drain Mana; [nochanneling,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nochanneling] Drain Life

keys.text: Life Tap, which also ends a channel

macros.needs: Drain Mana learned (level 24). Blizzard removed Dark Pact, so Alt is Life Tap
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:alt] Conversão de Vida; [nochanneling,mod:ctrl] Drenar Mana; [nochanneling,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nochanneling] Drenar Vida

macros.title: Pet attack, recall and passive on one key
macros.desc: Send your demon at your target, or your mouseover with Shift, call it back with Ctrl or set it to passive with Alt.
macros.needs: A living demon
macros.codePt:
/petattack [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nomod:ctrl,nomod:alt,harm,nodead]
/petfollow [mod:ctrl]
/petpassive [mod:alt]

macros.title: Drop your cast and Shadow Ward
macros.desc: Cancel your cast and put up Shadow Ward when a shadow caster starts on you.
macros.needs: Shadow Ward learned (level 32). It has a 30 second cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Proteção contra Sombra
/stopcasting
/cast Proteção contra Sombra

macros.title: Assist, then curse or Bane
macros.desc: Assist the friendly player you're targeting and open with Bane of Agony on their target, or a curse on a modifier.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/assist [help,nodead]
/cast [harm,nodead,mod:shift] Curse of Tongues; [harm,nodead,mod:ctrl] Curse of Exhaustion; [harm,nodead] Bane of Agony

keys.text: Bane of Agony on your ally's target

macros.needs: A friendly player targeted; Curse of Exhaustion talent for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/assist [help,nodead]
/cast [harm,nodead,mod:shift] Maldição de Línguas; [harm,nodead,mod:ctrl] Maldição da Exaustão; [harm,nodead] Ruína da Agonia

macros.title: Death Coil or Fear your last target
macros.desc: Cancel your cast, Death Coil your previous target and swing back to your current one, or hold Shift to Fear the previous target instead.

keys.text: Death Coil your previous target, then swap back
Fear your previous target, then swap back

macros.needs: Death Coil learned (level 42); a previous target to swap to
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/targetlasttarget
/cast [mod:shift] Medo; Espiral da Morte
/targetlasttarget

macros.title: Break free with your racial
macros.desc: Press to use whichever of these racials your warlock has: Will to Survive, Will of the Forsaken, Escape Artist or Shatter Curse.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast Will to Survive
/cast Will of the Forsaken
/cast Escape Artist
/cast Shatter Curse
macros.needs: A Human (removes Stuns), Undead (removes Charm, Fear and Sleep), Gnome (breaks movement-impairing effects) or Orc (removes Curses and Banes) warlock. The other lines do nothing for your race
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast Desejo de Sobreviver
/cast Determinação dos Renegados
/cast Artista da Fuga
/cast Estilhaçar Maldição

macros.title: Felhunter Spell Lock on your mouseover or target
macros.desc: Send the Felhunter's Spell Lock at your mouseover with Shift, or at whatever it's already fighting.

keys.text: Spell Lock your demon's target, or yours if it has none

macros.needs: A living Felhunter (level 30)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Bloquear Feitiço
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][@pettarget,harm,nodead][] Bloquear Feitiço

macros.title: Felhunter Devour Magic on yourself or a friend
macros.desc: Devour Magic your mouseover or target, or yourself with Shift.

keys.text: Devour Magic your mouseover, or your target

macros.needs: A living Felhunter
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Devorar Magia
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,exists,nodead][] Devorar Magia

macros.title: Felhunter Devour Magic on your party
macros.desc: Clear a magic effect off your first party member without targeting them, or hold a modifier for the second, third or fourth. In a battleground raid that's your own group of five.

keys.text: Devour Magic on your first party member
Devour Magic on your second party member
Devour Magic on your third party member
Devour Magic on your fourth party member

macros.needs: A living Felhunter. Party members are numbered in the order the default party frames list them
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Devorar Magia
/cast [mod:shift,@party2][mod:ctrl,@party3][mod:alt,@party4][@party1] Devorar Magia

macros.title: Succubus Seduction on your mouseover or target
macros.desc: Send the Succubus at your mouseover with Shift, or at the enemy it's already fighting.

keys.text: Seduce your demon's target, or yours if it has none

macros.needs: A living Succubus. We haven't confirmed whether the Incubus has Seduction
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sedução
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][@pettarget,harm,nodead][] Sedução

macros.title: Seduce your mouseover and Fear your target
macros.desc: Hover a second enemy and press: your Succubus seduces that one while you start Fear on your target. With nothing hovered it's a plain Fear.
macros.needs: A living Succubus and Fear learned. Damage on either enemy can break the effect
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Medo
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead] Sedução
/cast Medo

macros.title: Your demon's key ability on one button
macros.desc: Press for Fire Shield, Sacrifice, Spell Lock or Seduction, whichever your current demon has.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet:imp] Fire Shield; [pet:voidwalker] Sacrifice; [pet:felhunter] Spell Lock; [pet:succubus] Seduction
macros.needs: A living demon
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet:imp] Escudo de Fogo; [pet:voidwalker] Sacrificar; [pet:felhunter] Bloquear Feitiço; [pet:succubus] Sedução

macros.title: Rank 1 Rain of Fire to flush stealth
macros.desc: Drop the cheapest Rain of Fire on a flag room or a node you're guarding. Its ticks pull any rogue or druid inside out of stealth. Click the ground to place it.
macros.needs: Rain of Fire learned (level 20). Rank 1 costs 295 Mana, against 1,185 for rank 4
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast Chuva de Fogo(Grau 1)

macros.title: Spread dots with one button
macros.desc: Put Corruption on your mouseover or target, or hold a modifier for Bane of Agony or Siphon Life.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Bane of Agony; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Siphon Life; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Corruption
macros.needs: Siphon Life talent (level 30). Bane of Agony can sit on the same player as a curse
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Ruína da Agonia; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Sifão de Vida; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Corrupção

macros.title: Instant dot sequence for kiting
macros.desc: Press while you run: Curse of Exhaustion, Corruption, Bane of Agony, then Siphon Life on your target. Hold Shift to lead with Curse of Tongues on a caster.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [mod:shift] reset=target/combat Curse of Tongues, Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life; reset=target/combat Curse of Exhaustion, Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life

keys.text: Exhaustion, then Corruption, Bane of Agony and Siphon Life
Tongues, then Corruption, Bane of Agony and Siphon Life

macros.needs: Curse of Exhaustion and Siphon Life talents, and 5 points in Improved Corruption so Corruption is instant. In Forever a Bane and a Curse can sit on the same enemy. It starts over when you change target or leave combat
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [mod:shift] reset=target/combat Maldição de Línguas, Corrupção, Ruína da Agonia, Sifão de Vida; reset=target/combat Maldição da Exaustão, Corrupção, Ruína da Agonia, Sifão de Vida

macros.title: Amplify Curse into Curse of Exhaustion
macros.desc: Cancel your cast, pop Amplify Curse and slow your mouseover or target with Curse of Exhaustion. If Amplify is cooling down you still get the slow.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Curse of Exhaustion
/stopcasting
/cast Amplify Curse
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Curse of Exhaustion
macros.needs: Amplify Curse and Curse of Exhaustion talents. Amplify makes the slow stronger and has a 3 minute cooldown. Pressed in the first 1.5 seconds of another cast, the curse doesn't go out, so press again
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Maldição da Exaustão
/stopcasting
/cast Amplificar Maldição
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Maldição da Exaustão

macros.title: Amplify Curse into Curse of Weakness
macros.desc: Pop Amplify Curse and put Curse of Weakness on the rogue or warrior hitting you, on your mouseover or target. Amplify makes the curse 50% stronger.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Curse of Weakness
/cast Amplify Curse
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Curse of Weakness
macros.needs: Amplify Curse talent (3 minute cooldown). In Forever Curse of Weakness lowers the Physical damage the enemy deals. You get one curse per enemy, so it replaces Exhaustion or Tongues
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Maldição da Fraqueza
/cast Amplificar Maldição
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Maldição da Fraqueza

macros.title: Instant Shadow Bolt when Shadow Trance procs
macros.desc: When Shadow Trance lights up, press to stop your drain or cast and fire the instant Shadow Bolt at your target, or at your mouseover with Shift.

keys.text: Cancel your cast and Shadow Bolt your target
Cancel your cast and Shadow Bolt your mouseover

macros.needs: Nightfall talent. Without Shadow Trance it starts a normal 3 second Shadow Bolt. Pressed in the first 1.5 seconds of a drain or cast, it only cancels that
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta Sombria
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Seta Sombria

macros.title: Rank 1 Corruption to keep stealthers out
macros.desc: Tag a rogue or druid on your mouseover or target with rank 1 Corruption, which costs 35 Mana. Its ticks keep knocking them out of stealth, and each one can still trigger Nightfall.
macros.needs: 5 points in Improved Corruption, or it's a 2 second cast. A higher rank of your own Corruption already on that enemy blocks it
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Corrupção
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Corrupção(Grau 1)

macros.title: Mouseover Wrack without clipping it
macros.desc: Channel Wrack on your mouseover or target once your dots are ticking. Presses during the channel won't restart it.
macros.needs: Wrack talent (needs Siphon Life, level 40). For its 6 seconds your other Shadow dots hit that enemy 10% harder
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Destruição
/cast [nochanneling:Wrack,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nochanneling:Wrack] Destruição

macros.title: Soul Link, or Fel Domination and a new demon
macros.desc: With a demon out it casts Soul Link. With none it summons a Felhunter, or a Voidwalker with Shift, using Fel Domination first in combat.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet] Soul Link
/stopmacro [@pet,exists,nodead]
/cast [combat] Fel Domination
/cast [mod:shift] Summon Voidwalker; Summon Felhunter

keys.text: Soul Link, or a Felhunter if no demon is out
Summon a Voidwalker instead when no demon is out

macros.needs: Soul Link (level 30) and Fel Domination talents. Soul Link ends when your demon dies, so press again once the new one is out. With 2 points in Master Summoner the fast summon takes about half a second
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet] Vínculo Anímico
/stopmacro [@pet,exists,nodead]
/cast [combat] Dominância Vil
/cast [mod:shift] Evocar Emissário do Caos; Evocar Caçador Vil

macros.title: Spell Lock, or Fel Domination for a new Felhunter
macros.desc: With your Felhunter out it Spell Locks the enemy it's fighting, or your mouseover with Shift. Without one it summons a Felhunter, with Fel Domination first in combat.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet:felhunter,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][pet:felhunter,@pettarget,harm,nodead][pet:felhunter] Spell Lock
/stopmacro [pet:felhunter]
/cast [combat] Fel Domination
/cast Summon Felhunter

keys.text: Spell Lock, or summon a Felhunter if it isn't out

macros.needs: Fel Domination talent and Summon Felhunter (level 30). Any other demon you have out gets replaced. Improved Felhunter takes up to 6 seconds off Spell Lock's cooldown
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet:felhunter,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][pet:felhunter,@pettarget,harm,nodead][pet:felhunter] Bloquear Feitiço
/stopmacro [pet:felhunter]
/cast [combat] Dominância Vil
/cast Evocar Caçador Vil

macros.title: Sacrifice, Fel Domination and re-summon
macros.desc: In a fight, sacrifice the Voidwalker for its shield and bring a new one back fast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Sacrifice
/stopmacro [nocombat][nopet:voidwalker]
/cast Sacrifice
/cast Fel Domination
/cast Summon Voidwalker
macros.needs: A living Voidwalker and the Fel Domination talent (level 25). The Sacrifice shield now scales with 10% of your spell healing
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sacrificar
/stopmacro [nocombat][nopet:voidwalker]
/cast Sacrificar
/cast Dominância Vil
/cast Evocar Emissário do Caos

macros.title: Sacrifice mid-fight and bring a new demon fast
macros.desc: Sacrifice your demon, then Fel Domination and a Voidwalker in the same press, or a modifier for another demon. A sacrificed Felhunter restores 3% of your health every 4 seconds.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Demonic Sacrifice
/stopmacro [nopet]
/cast Demonic Sacrifice
/cast Fel Domination
/cast [mod:shift] Summon Felhunter; [mod:ctrl] Summon Succubus; Summon Voidwalker
macros.needs: Demonic Sacrifice, Fel Domination and Demonic Pact talents, with a demon out. Pact keeps the effect when a different demon arrives; summoning the one you sacrificed ends it
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sacrifício Demoníaco
/stopmacro [nopet]
/cast Sacrifício Demoníaco
/cast Dominância Vil
/cast [mod:shift] Evocar Caçador Vil; [mod:ctrl] Evocar Súcubo; Evocar Emissário do Caos

macros.title: Health Funnel, Shift to sacrifice instead
macros.desc: Keep your demon up with Health Funnel without restarting the channel. If it's going down anyway, hold Shift to sacrifice it for the 2 hour effect.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Demonic Sacrifice; Health Funnel
/cast [mod:shift] Demonic Sacrifice; [@pet,exists,nodead,nochanneling:Health Funnel] Health Funnel

keys.text: Health Funnel your demon without restarting it

macros.needs: Demonic Sacrifice talent and a living demon. Without Demonic Pact, summoning any demon ends the effect
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Sacrifício Demoníaco; Funil de Vida
/cast [mod:shift] Sacrifício Demoníaco; [@pet,exists,nodead,nochanneling:Health Funnel] Funil de Vida

macros.title: Brand an enemy with Searing Pain for your demon
macros.desc: Send your demon at your mouseover or target and Searing Pain it, so the demon's next few hits on that enemy deal extra Fire or Shadow damage.
macros.needs: Demonic Brand talent and a demon out. The brand lasts 10 seconds and covers up to 6 pet attacks at 3 points
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Dor Lancinante
/petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead]
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Dor Lancinante

macros.title: Searing Pain into a Decimation Soul Fire
macros.desc: Hold Shift for Searing Pain on an enemy under 35% health, then press for Soul Fire, which Decimation makes faster and free of shards for 10 seconds.
macros.needs: Decimation talent and Soul Fire (level 48). At 2 points Decimation also cuts Soul Fire's 1 minute cooldown by 90%. Shadow Bolt triggers it as well
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Dor Lancinante; Fogo d'Alma

macros.title: Trinkets, racial and a nuke
macros.desc: Use both trinkets and your Orc or Troll racial, then cast Shadow Bolt, or a modifier for Conflagrate or Shadowburn.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Blood Fury
/cast Berserking
/cast [mod:shift] Conflagrate; [mod:ctrl] Shadowburn; Shadow Bolt
macros.needs: On-use trinkets if you have them; Blood Fury (Orc) or Berserking (Troll) if that's your race; Conflagrate and Shadowburn talents for the modifiers
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast Berserk
/cast [mod:shift] Conflagrar; [mod:ctrl] Sombra Ardente; Seta Sombria

macros.title: Immolate, Conflagrate, Shadowburn burst
macros.desc: Press it three times for Immolate, Conflagrate and Shadowburn on your target, or hold Shift to lead with Curse of the Elements. Changing target starts it over.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [mod:shift] reset=target Curse of the Elements, Immolate, Conflagrate, Shadowburn; reset=target Immolate, Conflagrate, Shadowburn

keys.text: Curse of the Elements, then the same three

macros.needs: Conflagrate and Shadowburn talents and a Soul Shard. If Conflagrate or Shadowburn is still cooling down, that press does nothing until it's ready
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [mod:shift] reset=target Maldição dos Elementos, Imolação, Conflagrar, Sombra Ardente; reset=target Imolação, Conflagrar, Sombra Ardente

macros.title: Drop your cast and Shadowburn
macros.desc: Cancel your Shadow Bolt and finish your target with an instant Shadowburn before the heal lands, or your mouseover with Shift.

keys.text: Cancel your cast and Shadowburn your target
Cancel your cast and Shadowburn your mouseover

macros.needs: Shadowburn talent and a Soul Shard; 15 second cooldown. Pressed in the first 1.5 seconds of another cast, it only cancels that cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sombra Ardente
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Sombra Ardente

macros.desc: Cancel your cast and Conflagrate your target, or your mouseover with Shift. With 5 points in Aftermath every Conflagrate dazes them, slowing them by 50% for 5 seconds.

keys.text: Cancel your cast and Conflagrate your target
Cancel your cast and Conflagrate your mouseover

macros.needs: Conflagrate talent and your Immolate on the target; Aftermath for the daze. Pressed in the first 1.5 seconds of another cast, it only cancels that cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Conflagrar
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Conflagrar

macros.desc: Searing Pain your mouseover or target. It's your shortest cast, so it's the one to keep going while someone's hitting you.

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Dor Lancinante
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Dor Lancinante

macros.title: Bane of Havoc or Bane of Agony on one key
macros.desc: Put Bane of Havoc on your mouseover or target, such as their healer, so 15% of your damage to other enemies hits it too. Hold Shift for Bane of Agony on your target.

#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Bane of Agony; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Bane of Havoc

keys.text: Bane of Havoc on your mouseover or target
Bane of Agony on your target

macros.needs: Bane of Havoc talent. Havoc sits on one enemy at a time, and each enemy holds one Bane from you
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Ruína da Agonia; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Ruína Devastadora

macros.desc: Open on an enemy who hasn't seen you: your demon runs in as Soul Fire starts. Pyroclasm gives the hit a chance to stun.
macros.needs: Soul Fire (level 48), which costs a Soul Shard and has a 1 minute cooldown. Pyroclasm adds the stun chance, and 5 points in Bane take 2 seconds off its 6 second cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo d'Alma
/stopmacro [noharm][dead]
/petattack
